name: habits
description: Standing instructions for an AI agent as one markdown file each: habits (rules, always on or triggered) and SOPs (procedures). Installs one small generated block in CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md pointing at a private ~/.claude-user-data folder. Ships a library of example habits to adopt, and skills to add, adopt, update, remove, list, check and share habits, write and run SOPs, sync, and verify the prompt wiring.
